sentences.text:
Court No. - 1 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 6258 of 2023 Applicant :- Smt. Priyanka @ Kirti Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Shyam Sunder Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and the learned AGA for the State.

.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to direct the learned Civil Judge (Junior Division)/Fast Track Court, Crime Against Women, Fatehpur to decide Criminal Case No.
3991 of 2019 (State vs. Arvind) arising out of Case Crime No. 2 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 323,
506 IPC and 3/4 of D.P. Act, P.S. Mahila Thana, District- Fatehpur expeditiously within stipulated period.

entities.text: Civil Judge (Junior Division)/Fast Track Court, Crime Against Women, Fatehpur
entities.label: COURT

entities.text:
Criminal Case No.
3991 of 2019 (State vs. Arvind)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant is the first informant in the instant case and charges against the accused persons in the said case have already been framed on 27.9.2021, however, since then the trial has been pending and lingering-on, on one pretext or the other and has not yet been concluded.

sentences.text:
In view of the above, the Civil Judge (Junior Division)/Fast Track Court, Crime Against Women,
Fatehpur is expected to make all endeavours to decide the aforesaid trial expeditiously, preferably within a period of one year from the date of filing of certified copy of this order after giving opportunity of hearing to both the parties without giving any unnecessary adjournments to either parties and there is no other legal impediment in concluding the aforesaid trial.

entities.text:
Civil Judge (Junior Division)/Fast Track Court, Crime Against Women,
Fatehpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: With the aforesaid observations, this application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed of.
